name: Guess the Tag Before It Flips
why_it_works: Asking someone to guess a number makes them commit to an answer in their head. Once they have a guess, they have to stay to find out if they were right, and the gap between their guess and the real {{price}} is what they remember.

hook.pattern: Show the item, hide the price, and dare the viewer to guess before the tag flips.
examples: Comment your guess before the tag flips.
Everyone guesses double. Let's see if you do.

variables.name: item
variables.description: The thing whose price is hidden, 5 words or fewer

variables.name: price
variables.description: The real price a buyer pays, shown last

variables.name: clue_one
variables.description: First detail that hints at value, lowercase, reads after 'It's', 8 words or fewer
variables.example: hand-set by one jeweler, not a machine

variables.name: clue_two
variables.description: Second detail that hints at value, lowercase, reads after 'It comes with', 6 words or fewer

variables.name: offer
variables.description: What the viewer gets for acting, starts with a capital letter, 5 words or fewer

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 product photo of the {{item}} on a dark velvet surface, single warm spotlight, a blank price tag face-down beside it, shallow depth of field
Extreme close-up macro of the craft detail on the {{item}}, raking side light showing texture, dark background, vertical 9:16
The {{item}} resting in an open {{brand}} box with care card visible, soft window light from the left, top-down vertical 9:16
Hand flips the face-down price tag next to the {{item}} to reveal the number, slow motion, warm spotlight, locked-off vertical 9:16 camera

slides.headline: Guess the price
slides.body: Write your guess down before you swipe.
slides.visual_prompt: {{item}} on dark velvet, single warm spotlight, blank face-down price tag, 4:5

slides.headline: Clue one
slides.visual_prompt: Macro of the craft detail on the {{item}}, raking light, dark background

slides.headline: Clue two
slides.visual_prompt: {{item}} in an open {{brand}} box with care card, soft window light, top-down

slides.headline: Last chance to change your guess
slides.visual_prompt: The face-down tag in sharp focus, {{item}} blurred behind it

slides.headline: {{price}}
slides.body: That's the real number. No catch.
slides.visual_prompt: Price tag flipped face-up next to the {{item}}, bold number, warm light

slides.headline: What {{price}} actually covers
slides.body: The {{item}}, {{clue_two}}, and no fees added at checkout.
slides.visual_prompt: Clean itemized receipt-style card listing what the price includes, {{brand}} colors

slides.headline: Save this: how to judge any price
slides.body: Ask three things. What is it made of? Who made it? What do you get after you buy?
slides.visual_prompt: Simple three-item checklist card with small icons, warm neutral background, 4:5

slides.headline: Were you close?
slides.body: {{offer}}. Tell us your guess in the comments.
slides.visual_prompt: {{brand}} logo card on velvet with the offer in large clean type

craft.notes: Force a guess in the first line, then feed two value clues before the number so the guess drifts upward. The reveal lands best when the real price is lower than the clues made them expect.

do_not: Use this when the price is genuinely high and the clues cannot justify it; the reveal then reads as a rip-off
Hide fees, taxes or required add-ons behind the revealed number
Reveal the price in the caption or thumbnail and kill the tension
compliance: Real estate: the revealed price must be the current list price; include brokerage name and license number on screen per state rules
Real estate: follow Fair Housing rules; describe the property, never the kind of buyer it suits
Any niche: the price shown must be the real price a buyer pays, with required fees stated
